purpose: Bind one future ChEMBL 37 archive acquisition and one leakage-safe support compilation. This tracked claim creates no authority to acquire or open the archive until the missing real-source adapter bindings are accepted, integrated and copied into the private consumed claim receipt.

challenge_source.allowed_capability: Read only authenticated challenge training molecule identities, raw structures, label-free development/confirmatory membership and frozen outer/inner component-fold identities needed for overlap and family exclusion.
challenge_source.forbidden_capability: Do not parse target columns, features, confirmatory truth, historical row-level outcomes, blinded-test identities or any metric input.

preconditions: This exact tracked claim is reviewed, integrated as one signed commit, and green on post-main CI.

A separately reviewed additive real-source adapter, acquisition wrapper, official-shaped synthetic driver and byte-identical two-root acceptance are integrated and bind all five future consumption fields.
Every parent and accepted source hash still matches, the exact host paths are absent, and /usr/bin/unshare supports a fresh user and network namespace.

Only the receipt-bound label-free challenge training structure and fold capability may be opened during support compilation; official targets, features, confirmatory truth, historical outcomes and blinded-test inputs remain forbidden.
consumption.atomicity: Consumption is the atomic no-replace creation of attempt_root plus a private consumed-claim receipt binding every future source hash. Once created, the claim remains consumed after download, checksum, adapter, resource, support, integrity or cleanup failure.
consumption.network_boundary: Permit exactly one HTTPS download request for the frozen archive URL into archive_path. Verify the complete archive SHA-256 before listing or extraction. Extraction, SQLite target verification, activity compilation, chemistry, topology, support decision and receipt publication run under /usr/bin/unshare --user --map-root-user --net with no network.
consumption.read_boundary: Open the extracted SQLite database and fixed challenge_source root read-only and immutable. Do not alter either source, query an API, substitute a mirror, parse a forbidden challenge capability, or retain row-level source data in Git.
consumption.no_replace: No retry, resume, range request, alternate URL, mirror, release, format, moved root, overwritten root, manual row repair, source edit, threshold edit, partial reuse or second acquisition is authorized.

target_verification_before_activity_quer.failure: Any missing or mismatched target metadata rejects EXP-X1 before an activity query.

support_falsifier.decision_input: Aggregate unique standardized-molecule and union-component counts only after global exact/equivalent challenge removal and cell-scoped family exclusion.
support_falsifier.decision_lineage: The terminal support decision must bind the accepted compiler hash, all challenge_source receipts, the filtered external capability receipt, the complete union-node/edge/component receipt, and every per-cell safe-identity receipt.
support_falsifier.failure: Any failed endpoint, cell, integrity gate or resource gate rejects EXP-X1 before a fit with no source fallback, threshold repair, source addition or model operation.

resource_falsifier.rule: Measure the sole complete acquisition and compilation. Exceeding any ceiling rejects EXP-X1; no retry or optimization is authorized under this claim.

public_aggregate_only: source release, URL, archive and extracted-member hashes
challenge source revision and receipt hashes
target verification, ordered filter counts and preservation accounting
per-endpoint and per-cell unique-molecule/component support counts
comparison, timing, CPU, RSS, storage, authority and claim accounting
restricted_only: standardized external structures and per-cell capability rows
terminal_receipt.publication: Publish aggregate receipt once with no replace and no row-level external values, structures or predictions.

delete_after_aggregate_receipt_acceptanc: attempt_root including archive_path, extract_root, private_root and terminal_root
retain: receipt_root aggregate hashes, counts, resources, accounting, decision and cleanup receipt
cleanup.receipt_publication: Keep receipt_root absent until every terminal aggregate and cleanup fact is complete, then publish it atomically with no replace and remove all write bits. No mutable terminal or row-level state may exist outside attempt_root.
cleanup.failure: Any archive, extracted database, row-level capability or mutable terminal retained outside the fixed restricted attempt root, or any incomplete required deletion, is terminal.

post_adapter_integration_authority.precondition: All consumption preconditions pass and a private consumed claim binds the accepted adapter milestone without modifying this tracked claim.

next_gate: Review and integrate this exact claim and require green post-main CI.
